create_DataTransforms_pipeline: create a DataTransforms pipeline from config to apply multiple transforms to AtomicData objects
run_ani1x_transform: run the ani1x_transform function to center a molecule in a periodic cell with fixed atoms
run_qm9_transform: run the qm9_transform function to prepare QM9 molecular data with periodic boundary conditions
run_decompose_tensor: run decompose_tensor to decompose a rank-2 tensor into irreducible representation components
run_ensure_tensor: run ensure_tensor to convert specified attributes of an AtomicData object into PyTorch tensors
